lines.en: label utaspring3:
scene nightsky
Yet another inconsistency in weather has prompted me to seek out a means of thermoregulation as I make my way over to the bath house.
lines.zh: 天气又一次反常，逼得我在前往澡堂的路上寻找调节体温的办法。

lines.en: And while this constant swapping of cold for heat and heat for cold does wonders in keeping me on my toes, sometimes I just want to feel a lot of one thing.
lines.zh: 虽然冷热交替、忽冷忽热在让我时刻保持警觉方面效果奇佳，但有时候我只想好好地感受某一种东西。

lines.en: Normally, that thing is sadness. Or boner. But tonight, that thing is being hot. So I will submerge myself fully in the hottest water I can find while some girl with green hair complains to me.
lines.zh: 通常那样东西是悲伤。或者勃起。不过今晚，那样东西是热。所以我要把自己整个泡进我能找到的最烫的水里，同时听某个绿头发的女孩对我抱怨。

lines.en: : Welcome in!
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临！

lines.en: scene utaisio1
: Wow. You look different today, Io.
lines.zh: : 哇。你今天看起来不太一样啊，Io。

lines.en: scene utaisio2
: Really? Must be my new medication. One of the potential side effects was larger boobs and purple eyes.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？一定是我的新药吧。潜在的副作用之一就是胸变大、眼睛变紫。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I still like you more than Uta either way.
lines.zh: : 别担心。不管怎样我还是喜欢你多过 Uta。

lines.en: scene utaisio3
: Hey! That hurts! Even if you already knew it was me and you’re only saying that to get on my nerves!
lines.zh: : 喂！这话伤人！哪怕你早就知道是我，说这个只是为了气我！

lines.en: : Oh, wow. Is that actually you, Uta?
lines.zh: : 哦，哇。真的是你吗，Uta？

lines.en: scene utaisio4
: Stop pretending you don’t immediately recognize me! I have a complex, remember?!
lines.zh: : 别装作你没能立刻认出我来！我有心结的，记得吗？！

lines.en: : I just don’t think I can know for sure it’s you unless you flash me.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，除非你让我看一眼，否则我无法确信那就是你。

lines.en: scene utaisio5
: Ah-hah! A trick! Now there’s the Sensei I know and love.
lines.zh: : 啊哈！是陷阱！这才是我认识并且喜欢的 Sensei。

lines.en: scene utaisio6

: {size=-5}Which means I must now apologize as what you are asking is beyond the capabilities of what I am legally allowed to do as an employee of the bath house and the daughter of parents who are already very disappointed in me.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-5}那么我现在必须道歉，因为你所要求的已经超出了我作为澡堂员工、以及作为一对早就对我失望透顶的父母的女儿，在法律上被允许做的事。{/size}

lines.en: : They don’t need to know.
lines.zh: : 他们不需要知道。

lines.en: scene utaisio7
: They do, though. You know the rule. No freaky business until there’s a really uncomfortable phone call.
lines.zh: : 不，他们需要。你懂规矩的。在打完那通让人尴尬到死的电话之前，不许干奇怪的事。

lines.en: : How would that call even go?
lines.zh: : 那通电话到底会怎么发展？

lines.en: : Probably like...
lines.zh: : 大概是这样……

lines.en: scene utaisio8
: Hi, Mom! Hi, Dad! It’s your beloved little girl, Uta! So — remember that time you made me move to Kumon-mi because some creepy old guy wanted to screw me?
lines.zh: : 嗨，妈妈！嗨，爸爸！是你们心爱的小女儿 Uta 呀！那么——还记得你们因为某个猥琐老男人想睡我而让我搬到 Kumon-mi 的事吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Well, that’s happening again. But I like him this time so I want your permission to-
lines.zh: : 对。嗯，那种事又要发生了。不过这次我喜欢他，所以我想要你们的许可——

lines.en: : What’s that? I need to move {i}again?{/i} Darn!
lines.zh: : 什么？我{i}又{/i}得搬家？该死！

lines.en: scene utaisio9
: Then a helicopter comes and carries me away to Nagano or something where the cycle repeats and I fall for someone else who’s way too old for me.
lines.zh: : 然后就会来一架直升机，把我带到 Nagano 还是什么地方去，循环重演，我又会爱上另一个对我来说明显太老的人。

lines.en: : Which is precisely why you should avoid the phone call entirely and just flash and/or marry me already.
lines.zh: : 所以你才该完全避开那通电话，干脆现在就让我看一眼、或者嫁给我。

lines.en: : Did you bring a ring this time?
lines.zh: : 你这次带戒指了吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: scene utaisio10
: Then both of your wishes will {i}not{/i} come true!
lines.zh: : 那么你的两个愿望都{i}不会{/i}实现！

lines.en: : What are you even doing here, Uta? Where’s Io? And...is that her robe?
lines.zh: : 你到底在这儿干什么，Uta？Io 呢？还有……那是她的浴衣吗？

lines.en: scene utaisio11
: Oh, no. I have my own. I help out here sometimes when Io and her aunt can’t make it. They’re at the doctor’s office right now.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是。我有自己的。Io 和她阿姨来不了的时候，我偶尔会过来帮忙。她们现在在诊所。

lines.en: : The doctor’s office? Is everything-
lines.zh: : 诊所？一切都还——

lines.en: : Totally fine, no worries. Doctors just make you do this thing sometimes where you have to physically show up if you want to keep getting the {i}good{/i} stuff.
lines.zh: : 完全没事，别担心。医生有时候就是会让你干这种事：想要继续拿到{i}好{/i}东西，就得亲自到场。

lines.en: : So Io and her aunt make a big trip once a year where they just try to knock out as many of her doctors as they can in one go. They won’t be back until tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 所以 Io 和她阿姨每年都会出一趟远门，尽量在一次性里把能看的医生都看完。她们明天才回来。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t it make more sense for her to just have everything prescribed by {i}one{/i} doctor?
lines.zh: : 让{i}一个{/i}医生把什么都开给她不是更合理吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I think there might be some kinda fraud thing going on. I haven’t ruled out that Io’s aunt isn’t running a secret drug cartel yet.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我觉得可能有某种诈骗在里头。我还没排除 Io 的阿姨在暗中经营贩毒集团的可能性。

lines.en: : Oh great, another subplot.
lines.zh: : 哦太好了，又一条支线。

lines.en: scene utaisio12

: Either way! Yours truly is here to make sure that you and anyone else can get naked with ease! Now please hand over your wallet as you so normally do, Sensei. Tipping is not mandatory, but expected.
lines.zh: : 总之！鄙人在此确保你和任何其他人都能轻松愉快地脱光光！现在请把钱包交出来吧，Sensei，就像你平时那样。小费不强制，但很受期待。

lines.en: : I have never had to tip Io in my life.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子从来不用给 Io 小费。

lines.en: : Do I look like Io to you?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像 Io 吗？

lines.en: : Like I said, I can’t be convinced you’re {i}really{/i} Uta until you flash me.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，除非你让我看一眼，否则我没法相信你{i}真的{/i}是 Uta。

lines.en: : Well, I’m not gonna {i}flash{/i} you before I’m paid. I don’t show these babies to just anybody, Sensei. It’s not 2015 anymore.
lines.zh: : 那我可不会在拿到钱之前{i}给你看{/i}。我这俩宝贝不是随便给人看的，Sensei。现在又不是 2015 年了。

lines.en: : See, we’re going to have a problem then. I didn't bring my wallet because Io stopped charging me a long time ago and just lets me bathe for free now.
lines.zh: : 那我们就有麻烦了。我没带钱包，因为 Io 很久以前就不收我钱了，现在让我免费泡。

lines.en: : And why should Uta do the same?
lines.zh: : 那 Uta 凭什么也这样？

lines.en: : Because she’ll get to see my penis on the cameras I know she has access to.
lines.zh: : 因为她能通过我知道她有权限调看的摄像头看到我的鸡巴。

lines.en: scene utaisio13
: And faint again?! You saw what happened the last time you showed me that thing! I was out for like twelve hours!
lines.zh: : 然后又晕过去？！你看到上次你给我看那玩意儿的结果了吧！我昏了大概十二个小时！

lines.en: : Technically, I didn’t {i}show{/i} you. You busted in and saw it on your own.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，我没{i}给你看{/i}。是你自己闯进来看见的。

lines.en: : Maybe I thought Io was in danger?! That thing was so big I could feel its presence from all the way down here!
lines.zh: : 也许我以为 Io 有危险呢？！那玩意儿大得我从这么远的地方都能感觉到它的存在！

lines.en: : Can you feel it now, Uta?
lines.zh: : 你现在感觉得到吗，Uta？

lines.en: scene utaisio14
: Mh?!
: {i}Can you feel my penis?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你能感觉到我的鸡巴吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene utaisio15
: Okay, fine! You don’t have to pay me! Just take that thing outta here before it robs the register and impregnates everyone within a five mile radius!
lines.zh: : 好，行！你不用付钱了！把那玩意儿弄走就行，趁它还没抢了收银机、让方圆五英里内的所有人怀孕！

lines.en: scene black
: Nice. Thanks, Uta. Enjoy the camera feed.
lines.zh: : 好。谢了，Uta。好好享受监控画面吧。

lines.en: : I will! I-I mean I {i}won’t!{/i} Because we definitely don’t have one!
lines.zh: : 我会的！我——我是说我{i}不会{/i}的！因为我们绝对没有那种东西！

lines.en: : Feel free to join if-
lines.zh: : 想一起来的话——

lines.en: : OKAY BYE!
lines.zh: : 好，再见！

lines.en: scene utaisio16
: Come on, come on, come on...
lines.zh: : 快点，快点，快点……

lines.en: : {i}Hello?{/i}
: Io, we’ve got a code blue over here.
lines.zh: : Io，我们这边出现蓝色警报了。

lines.en: scene utaisio17
: Someone {i}died?{/i} Why is it always on my day off?
lines.zh: : 有人{i}死了{/i}？为什么总是在我休息的日子？

lines.en: : {i}Nobody died! But somebody is about to die and that somebody is me!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没人死！但马上就要死人了，而那个人就是我！{/i}

lines.en: scene utaisio18
: Uta, I understand that Tsuneyo girl may be considered “conventionally attractive” by all of you. But if she’s there again, please don’t use the cameras to-
lines.zh: : Uta，我明白那个 Tsuneyo 在你们所有人眼里可能算“公认的美女”。但如果她又来了，请不要用摄像头去——

lines.en: : {i}No! I mean Sensei is here right now! He’s getting undressed as we speak!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不是！我是说 Sensei 现在就在这儿！他这会儿正在脱衣服！{/i}

lines.en: scene utaisio19
: Oh.
: So what?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？

lines.en: : {i}What do you mean SO WHAT?! How am I supposed to deal with this?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么叫所以呢？！我要怎么应付这个？！{/i}

lines.en: : By...continuing to sit at the counter and helping other customers who come in?
lines.zh: : 就是……继续坐在柜台后面，给进来的其他客人服务？

lines.en: : {i}Oh...yeah. I guess that makes sense. Sorry for the false alarm.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦……对。我想这倒也有道理。抱歉，虚惊一场。{/i}

lines.en: : Or you could go have sex with him.
lines.zh: : 或者你可以去跟他做爱。

lines.en: scene utaisio20
: PHBHTBHTHBTHBTHTHTHTH?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 噗噼噗噼噗噼噼噼？！？！？！

lines.en: scene utaisio21
: What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : {i}Yeah. Use my bed, though. Don’t make the bath all gross, please.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对啊。不过用我的床。别把浴室弄脏了，拜托。{/i}

lines.en: : What do you think you’re saying, Io?!
lines.zh: : 你以为自己在说什么啊，Io？！

lines.en: : {i}What? That’s what you...sex people do, right? Spare me the details, though. And please thoroughly clean my sheets when you’re done.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么？你们这种……做爱的人不就是干这个的吗？细节就免了。完事之后请把我的床单彻底洗干净。{/i}

lines.en: : I don’t want to have sex yet! I’m not ready!
lines.zh: : 我还不想做爱！我还没准备好！

lines.en: : {i}You sure sound ready. Your voice is like two octaves higher than normal.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你听起来可够准备好的。你的声音比平时高了得有两个八度。{/i}

lines.en: : Because penis, Io! Sensei penis! So close to Uta! What do?!
lines.zh: : 因为鸡巴啊，Io！Sensei 的鸡巴！离 Uta 这么近！怎么办？！

lines.en: : {i}Dude, what do you want me to tell you? Either do stuff or don’t do stuff. You like him, right? This could be your shot.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大姐，你想让我跟你说什么？要么做，要么不做。你喜欢他，对吧？这可能是你的机会。{/i}

lines.en: : But you like him too! And I’m at {i}your{/i} house! It’s sacrilegious!
lines.zh: : 可你也喜欢他啊！而且我还在{i}你{/i}家！这太亵渎了！

lines.en: : {i}Technically, it’s my aunt’s house. Do you want to talk to her? {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}严格来说，是我阿姨家。你想跟她说吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene utaisio22
: NO! OBVIOUSLY NOT!
lines.zh: : 不！显然不想！

lines.en: : {i}Cool! Bye then! Have fun!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}酷！那再见！玩得开心！{/i}

lines.en: scene black
: Io, you don’t- AAAAH! SHE HUNG UP!
lines.zh: : Io，你别——啊啊啊！她挂了！

lines.en: : WHAT AM I SUPPOSED TO DO?!?!?!?!
scene utaisio23
It was a sticky situation for Uta Ushibori — a girl who had just recently brought her “I’ve masturbated to my teacher” count into the triple digits.
lines.zh: 对 Uta Ushibori 来说，这是个棘手的局面——这个女孩最近刚把她“对着老师自慰”的次数刷到了三位数。

lines.en: Because on one hand, she {i}was{/i} perfectly capable of sitting behind the counter and just serving customers like Io suggested.
lines.zh: 因为一方面，她{i}确实{/i}完全能够像 Io 建议的那样，坐在柜台后面老老实实服务客人。

lines.en: scene utaisio24
But on the other, this {i}was{/i} a perfect opportunity to try and take things up a notch with someone she’d been borderline obsessing over for months, if not {i}years{/i} on end now.
lines.zh: 但另一方面，这也是个绝佳的机会，可以把她跟某个自己已经近乎痴迷了好几个月——甚至{i}好几年{/i}的人的关系再推进一步。

lines.en: The days all seemed to blur together. But in the midst of that incessant fog, there was one thing that was abundantly and permanently clear.
lines.zh: 所有的日子都模糊成了一片。但在那挥之不去的迷雾之中，有一件事是极其清晰、且永久清晰的。

lines.en: She had not learned a thing.
lines.zh: 她什么都没学到。

lines.en: : Um...{i}Ahem...{/i}
scene utaisio25
: I like where this is going.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢这个走向。

lines.en: scene utaisio26
: Y...You don’t mind if I join you, right?
lines.zh: : 我……你不介意我一起泡吧？

lines.en: : I...I uhhhh closed. The...shop. Early. B-But there are still some customers in the women’s side, so...
lines.zh: : 我……我呃呃呃打烊了。那个……店。提前。不——不过女汤那边还有几个客人，所以……

lines.en: : So you’d rather be naked and alone with your male teacher instead of other women.
lines.zh: : 所以你宁愿跟你的男老师赤裸相对，也不愿跟其他女人待在一起。

lines.en: scene utaisio27
: It sounds so...{i}impure{/i} when you...put it that way...
lines.zh: : 你这么……说出来……听起来好{i}下流{/i}……

lines.en: : Probably because it {i}is.{/i} You know what you’re doing right now.
lines.zh: : 大概因为它{i}本来就是{/i}。你清楚自己此刻在干什么。

lines.en: scene utaisio28
: That’s...uhh...yeah! I...know...but...
lines.zh: : 那是……呃……对！我……知道……可是……

lines.en: scene utaisio29
: D...Don’t just put me on the spot like that, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 别……别那样把我架在火上烤啊，Sensei……

lines.en: : Just because I know doesn’t...mean it’s not...{i}embarrassing...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道不代表……它就不……{i}让人难为情{/i}……

lines.en: scene utaisio30
: I want to destroy you.
lines.zh: : 我想毁掉你。

lines.en: : Hm? What? I didn’t-
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么？我没——

lines.en: : Nothing. Just know that you are putting yourself at risk by doing this and that I am not going to stop staring at you for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 没什么。你只要知道，你这么做是在把自己置于险境，而我今晚剩下的时间里都不会停止盯着你看。

lines.en: : Y...You can stare. I like it when...you stare, but...uhh...
lines.zh: : 你……你可以看。我喜欢……你盯着我看，可是……呃……

lines.en: : B-Before you start! Can you give me, like...five seconds to take my towel off and get in the bath?
lines.zh: : 不——不过在开始之前！你能给我，大概……五秒钟，让我把浴巾解掉、下到池子里吗？

lines.en: : You are going to walk in here looking like that and then tell me I can’t watch the best part?
lines.zh: : 你就这么走进来，然后告诉我不能看最精彩的部分？

lines.en: : B-Baby steps! Okay? We’ll...um...yeah. You’re...hot. Wow. Uhh. What was I...towel! Right. Towel. Eyes! Close. Five...s...seconds.
lines.zh: : 慢——慢慢来！好吗？我们会……呃……对。你……好烫。哇。呃。我刚才说……浴巾！对。浴巾。眼睛！闭上。五……秒……钟。

lines.en: : P...Please...
lines.zh: : 求……求你了……

lines.en: : M...{i}Master...{/i}
scene utaisio31
: Fine. But only because you called me “Master.”
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过只因为叫我了“主人”。

lines.en: scene black
: Yes, Master! Anything for you, Master!
lines.zh: : 是，主人！为了主人我什么都愿意做！

lines.zh: : 什么都愿意？那你不介意我——

lines.zh: : 啊！啊啊！不行！眼睛！保持闭上！就快好了！不许偷看！我要叫了！

lines.zh: : 如果你觉得{i}这就{/i}够糟了，那你该听听我脑子{i}里面{/i}在发生什么！

lines.en: scene utaisio32
It was a cacophony of unrepentant lust aimed directly at the heart and cock of a man who excelled when it came to the latter, but was completely undeveloped in terms of the former.
lines.zh: 那是一阵毫无悔意的欲念喧嚣，直指一个男人的心与鸡巴——后者他极为擅长，前者却完全未曾发育。

lines.en: This was quite the contrast to Uta Ushibori — a girl who, while ravenously horny, {i}still{/i} prioritized love and affection over carnal desire.
lines.zh: 这与 Uta Ushibori 形成了鲜明的对比——这个女孩虽然欲火中烧，却{i}依然{/i}把爱与温情置于肉欲之上。

lines.en: It would be so easy for her to just traipse her way over to the opposite end of the bath and ride this man until {i}both{/i} of them passed out from heat exhaustion, but she kept her distance.
lines.zh: 对她来说，就这么悠悠然走到澡堂的另一端，骑在这个男人身上，直到{i}两个{/i}人都因为体温过高而昏过去，简直易如反掌——可她保持着距离。

lines.en: She covered herself up — and while {i}some{/i} of that was designed to tease him and keep him wanting more, a greater portion of it was brought on by uncertainty.
lines.zh: 她把自己遮了起来——虽然其中{i}有一部分{/i}是为了撩他、让他想要更多，但更大一部分是出于不确定。

lines.en: She’d accepted she wouldn’t be the first. But if she timed things properly, she believed she could {i}still{/i} be the last.
